title: Quadratic mixing for the Lee--Sidford Dikin walk
summary: Let $K=\{x\in\R^d:Ax\ge b\}$ be a bounded full-dimensional polytope with $m$ inequalities. For targets on $K$ with density proportional to $\exp(-\vartheta^\transpose x)$, we prove a $\widetilde O(d^2)$ bound, measured in Markov chain iterations, for the chi-square mixing of the $1/2$-lazy Metropolis Dikin walk based on a polylogarithmically rescaled Lee--Sidford metric. The estimate holds for every initial law with finite chi-square divergence.
